Class Armor

java.lang.Object
model.items.concrete.Armor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Equipable, Item
public class Armor extends Object implements Equipable
Represents an Armor item that can be equipped by a PlayerCharacter.

Equipping armor increases the player's defense and decreases speed by 1. Each armor has a minimum required difficulty level to be equipped.
